kind: WeChat page logic regression in VM; not a simulator or device test

checks.name: Guests browse publicly and return through the existing login for mine, compose and voting
Category, sort and pagination build independent server queries and refuse invalid navigation
Private pending detail marks own progress read and cannot be shared
Published decisions share the stable public detail, while a withdrawn idea shares only the board
Account switching clears private addresses and ignores a late response from the previous account
Text drafts are account isolated; images and reward addresses are never persisted as drafts
Changing a nickname keeps the stable owner draft; a new account reusing the nickname cannot read it
Validation preserves drafts; duplicate taps cannot create two ideas
A failed image upload keeps the created pending idea and offers retry instead of resubmitting the text
Screenshot selection rejects oversized files, caps three images and previews only the selected set
Voting sends an idempotent target boolean, ignores duplicate taps, and honors author and closed-state restrictions
Expired login clears private claim data and routes back to exactly the same idea
Reward receipt requires owner eligibility and explicit consent before sending private data
Withdrawal and receiving rewards require confirmation and return authoritative server state
Mine progress badge loads quietly, ignores old-account responses and clears on logout or errors
My entry remains visible to guests and login-return only allows this known page shape
